title: Who is CJ Desai? MongoDB CEO set to join Meta Enterprise Platform for businesses; will report directly to Zuckerberg
summary: Chirantan ‘CJ’ Desai, CEO and President of MongoDB, has stepped down to join Meta Platforms as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, reporting directly to Mark Zuckerberg. Here's all we know.
